claim: The Drift faculty enforces eleven invariants on every detector it holds: a declared baseline with a stated reason, prime-then-diff, read-only observation, VACANT distinguished from BLIND, per-signal severity with no averaging, and correction that requires evidence, aims at the median, moves only partway, is recorded, and reaches the substrate's EXPECTATIONS while being unable to reach its LAWS.
hypothesis: If the vessel did not enforce these, an absorbed detector could opt out of them one at a time — which is exactly how the existing detectors came to disagree: each gets one thing right and the rest wrong. A cold start would read as drift, an unmeasurable guard would read as healthy, and a baseline could be moved on two data points.

checks.label: the detector carries a declared baseline
the baseline states WHY it is that value — not a chosen constant
checks.detail: a substrate that finishes three quarters of what it forms is closing its…

checks.label: its severity bands are ordered largest-first and each names a severity
the FIRST reading is VACANT, establishing footing rather than movement
and it is not counted as drift
the second reading is LIVE, with a real observed value from the substrate
it carries a computed magnitude against the declared expectation
nothing-to-measure reads VACANT and is NOT graded severe
a guard that COULD NOT be read is BLIND and CRITICAL — never defaulted down
neither is reported as drift — absence of a reading is not movement
the blind one is surfaced separately, as a blind spot
a detector that raises does not take the faculty down with it
the faculty exposes no aggregate score to average away a failing signal
it reports the WORST signal instead, so one healthy reading cannot pay for a broken one
7 — a correction on too little evidence is REFUSED
a correction with enough evidence is APPLIED
8 — it aimed at the MEDIAN, not the mean (outliers cannot drag a standard)
9 — it moved only part of the way, so the substrate converges not oscillates
10 — the self-correction is RECORDED, with what it was and why
the constitution's five laws are untouched by a drift correction
and its compliance threshold is untouched
correction reaches ONLY a detector's expectation — it has no handle on a law
checks.detail: no law-touching name appears in correct()

the coordinator holds ONE Drift faculty
a second detector under a live name is refused — one question, one authority

notes: `goal_conclusion_rate` reads the live intent authority over the real database; the VACANT and BLIND probes are real detector subclasses whose subjects genuinely do not exist / genuinely fail to read.
No existing detector (calibration, epistemic, standards, constitutional) is absorbed yet — that is step 2, one at a time against a parity benchmark. This proves the vessel's laws.
